electricityContract.terms: Up to 28 kWh of free electricity usage each day between 11am-3pm. Usage over 28 kWh during that time will be charged at Off - Peak time rates. Other charges, such as daily supply and controlled load charges still apply during that time. This offer is best suited if you can shift your usage to the free usage period, if you cannot, your electricity costs could be higher. Offer not available in all areas. Residential customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.

solarFeedInTariff.description: Origin offers 11 cents per kWh until a daily export limit of 10 kWh is reached during Peak hours between 6pm to 9pm all days. The daily export limit is averaged across your billing period (calculated by multiplying the number of days in your billing period by your daily export limit of 10 kWh). All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any)
For any amount above the Peak hour daily export, and all export during Off-Peak hours between 9pm to 6pm, you will receive 3 cents per kWh. All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any).
